# Orchestra

> A macOS desktop app that monitors AI coding agent sessions in real-time.

## Quick Facts

- Platform: macOS 11.0+
- Architecture: Apple Silicon (aarch64)
- Version: 0.1.0
- License: MIT

## Links

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/reverseblade/orchestra-desktop)

## Features

- Real-time Monitoring: Monitor all Claude Code sessions in real-time via Hooks integration
- Smart Cue System: Automatic notifications when agents need your attention
- One-click Jump: Jump to any session with tmux + iTerm2 integration
- Native macOS: Built with Tauri for a lightweight, native experience
